Container.Name: lightning-rss-reader
Container.Overview: Fast, mobile-first reader for FreshRSS (Google Reader API), installable as a PWA. The container serves the app, proxies the FreshRSS API and sends push notifications for new articles. Put it behind an HTTPS reverse proxy: HTTPS is required to install the PWA and for notifications.
Container.Requires: A FreshRSS instance with the API enabled, and an API password set in your FreshRSS profile.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the reader on the host. Point your HTTPS reverse proxy at it.

Config.Name: FreshRSS URL
Config.Description: FreshRSS address as seen from this container, without a trailing slash. For example http://192.168.1.10:8080 (host IP and FreshRSS port) or https://freshrss.example.com.

Config.Name: Notifications
Config.Description: Push notifications for new unread articles.

Config.Name: VAPID subject
Config.Description: Contact address sent to push services (Google, Mozilla...) with notifications.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Push notification keys and subscriptions (they include FreshRSS API tokens: keep this folder private). Must be writable by nobody:users (99:100).
